task.title: Resolve profile name errors
task.shortdesc: Fix an empty, duplicate, or unclear profile name during creation or clone.

prereq.p: A visible BPM status, validation message, browser warning, or failed action indicates that the current workflow cannot safely continue.

context.p: Profile names identify Library rows, editor tabs, comparison choices, imports, and recovery messages, so name validation blocks ambiguous saves.

step.cmd: Read the name validation hint before changing other profile fields.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Enter a non-empty name that distinguishes the profile purpose, Firefox channel, or source file.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: For clone workflows, change the suggested clone name before confirming if it duplicates an existing row.

info.p: Expected result: you preserve the profile state and understand the next safe recovery action.

step.cmd: Save or duplicate again after the name hint clears.

info.note: Do not edit internal storage, browser local data, database rows, or generated build artifacts to recover user-facing profile work.

result.p: The profile or clone has a unique visible name that can be found later in the Library.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the same error repeats after one clean retry, stop the workflow, preserve the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current surface for maintainer review.
